topic: Coloprice Top: largest operators by tracked facilities

facts: Catalogue: 2278 operators, 6075 facilities in 184 countries (as of 2026-10-29)
Largest by tracked facilities — #1 Equinix: 267 tracked facilities in 37 countries, 125 MW published (5 of 267 sites publish MW)
Largest by tracked facilities — #2 Digital Realty: 231 tracked facilities in 29 countries, 290 MW published (13 of 231 sites publish MW)
Largest by tracked facilities — #3 NTT Global Data Centers: 80 tracked facilities in 17 countries, 1,506 MW published (62 of 80 sites publish MW)
Largest by tracked facilities — #4 DataBank: 76 tracked facilities in 2 countries, 1,023 MW published (76 of 76 sites publish MW)
Largest by tracked facilities — #5 EdgeConneX: 56 tracked facilities in 16 countries, 575 MW published (26 of 56 sites publish MW)
Largest by tracked facilities — #6 STACK Infrastructure: 49 tracked facilities in 11 countries, 5,673 MW published (48 of 49 sites publish MW)
Largest by tracked facilities — #7 Cologix: 49 tracked facilities in 2 countries, 121 MW published (7 of 49 sites publish MW)
Largest by tracked facilities — #8 Iron Mountain: 48 tracked facilities in 7 countries, 1,000 MW published (44 of 48 sites publish MW)

caption:
267 facilities: Equinix tops the Coloprice catalogue of data centre operators.

Digital Realty follows with 231, then NTT Global Data Centers (80) and DataBank (76). Behind them the field is tight: STACK Infrastructure and Cologix both have 49.

Capacity tells a different story. STACK publishes 5,673 MW, while Equinix publishes 125 MW because only 5 of its 267 sites disclose MW. Largest by tracked facilities, not best and not an endorsement.
